name: Alias
documentation:
Marks a property whose current value is an alternative identifier for an entity or independently stored model.

Aliases are used when looking for an embedded entity via {@link Entity#getEntity}, when resolving a legacy aggregate through {@link Fluxzero#loadAggregateFor}, and when loading an independent model through {@link Fluxzero#loadModel(Object)}.

You can annotate fields and property methods. If a property value is a collection the members of the collection are all added as aliases of the entity. If the property value is {@code null} or an empty collection the alias is ignored.

On an independently stored {@link Model}, the complete current alias set is replaced atomically with each model transition. A changed or deleted alias therefore stops resolving after that commit. Such aliases identify a model globally and must be unique across independently stored models. Generic loads give a primary model ID precedence over an equal alias. Aliases which are intentionally local to one aggregate tree should not be exposed as independent-model aliases.

With {@code fluxzero.model.aliasTargets=true}, a mutation property with the same name as an alias property selects through that alias when no explicit Graph, association, primary-ID property or typed ID selects the Model. Alias prefix/postfix settings apply to the selector. Several alias properties (or collection values) must select one owner; the selected value must match each found selector on its declared property. Equal values on different alias properties are not interchangeable. A present but null primary-ID property does not enable alias fallback.

All missing selectors permit a new Apply result with a valid primary ID and matching selectors. Mixed found/missing selectors update the found owner and require the final result to match every selector. Fully matched selections may change aliases or delete the owner. Generic loads and embedded/legacy entity lookup keep their existing contract. Enable this only with a Runtime advertising identity-selection version 1; unsupported peers reject the new requests before effects. The setting defaults to false before defaults version {@code 2026.10.18}.

methods.name: postfix
methods.documentation:
Adds given string as a postfix to the alias (if the property value is non-null). Useful to prevent clashes with
 other entity ids.

methods.name: prefix
methods.documentation:
Adds given string as a prefix to the alias (if the property value is non-null). Useful to prevent clashes with
 other entity ids.
